description: DataDecide's training setup at the eight replication sizes. N, D and steps are DataDecide's released values (data/datadecide_runs.parquet: params_n, tokens_d, final step; D = steps x batch x 2048 exactly); architecture, batch and peak LR from the DataDecide paper's Table 2 (arXiv 2504.11393, App. A) and the OLMo ladder code on the DataDecide branch; shared settings from that code.

sources.paper_table: arXiv 2504.11393, Appendix A, Table 2 (also on the allenai/DataDecide-* model cards)

shared.architecture: decoder-only, SwiGLU, mlp_ratio 8, RoPE, RMSNorm with affine eps 1e-6, no biases, untied embeddings, init normal std 0.02 truncated at 3 std
shared.lr_rule: 0.0047 (N/108e6)^(-1/3); the table's published value is used
shared.tokens: 5xC = 100 N (nominal N for 150M and 300M; D as released)

seed_controls: initialisation and data order (TrainConfig.seed, data.seed unset). Use the DataDecide branch: at commit 55d4871 the seed is hard-coded to 6198.

evaluation.metric: c4_en_bits_per_token: mean next-token cross-entropy on held-out C4-en validation, in nats divided by ln 2, at the final checkpoint
evaluation.data: DataDecide's in-loop c4_en-validation file: OLMo eval-data/perplexity/v3_small_gptneox20b/c4_en/val/part-0-00000.npy (https://olmo-data.org/eval-data/perplexity/v3_small_gptneox20b/c4_en/val/part-0-00000.npy, sha256 c37d6b115de9120bfaefe9ca6a20a310eb6738c20bc26abf469dcada66100ab4) with its part-0-00000.csv.gz metadata; 2,099 documents, 1,021,899 tokens, listed by id and text hash in replication_protocol/eval_set.jsonl
evaluation.unverified: none for the evaluation set itself, which is the in-loop file pinned by sha256; its document-for-document relation to other releases is provenance only (see in_loop_file_check)
evaluation.decontamination: before tokenization, every training document whose SHA-256 of NFC-normalized text equals a sha256_nfc in replication_protocol/eval_set.jsonl is removed (scripts/decontaminate.py), and the matched evaluation ids are reported per corpus

in_loop_file_check.result: all 2,099 documents of DataDecide's in-loop c4_en-validation file are C4-en validation documents (allenai/c4 revision 1588ec45): 2,097 byte-identical and 2 identical after Unicode NFC normalization; 1,021,899 tokens; its metadata names Paloma v3_small c4_en/val source files
in_loop_file_check.paloma_identity: provenance only, not used by the protocol: the file's metadata names Paloma v3_small source files; identity with the gated HF Paloma release is unverified
